title: Backrooms: Found Footage
description: The Best Backrooms Experience for Minecraft
author: onr23
body:
# Backrooms: Found Footage
My Other Modpacks

The Best Backrooms Experience for Minecraft




--- ## How To Play To enter the Backroom world, once you create a world, you have to find a way to get buried, such as dropping blocks, sand, or gravel on yourself. Then you will be sent to the Backrooms * * * * * ### Basic Controls - Shift - Run - Ctrl - Sneak - F - Flashlight - C - Zoom - B - Set Up Voice Chat - Middle Mouse - Ping * * * * * * * * * * ## Description This modpack is a more stable version of the "Minecraft Backrooms Found Footage" mod with some gameplay improvements. ⚠️ **Minecraft Backrooms Found Footage Mod does not support performance mods like Sodium, Optifine or Vulkan, which can cause performance issues on low-end PCs.** **_A video by the creator of The Backrooms Mod_** ⬇️
